missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate the profile name element in the dashboard header and return its text value. This method should wait for the element to be visible before extracting the text.

Retrieve the profile name from the dashboard header using get_dashboard_header_profile_name() and assert that it matches the expected_name parameter. Should raise an assertion error with a descriptive message if the names do not match.
